performanceInterpretation: All samples/outliers retained. Shared-host concurrent workloads and changed order prevent a reliable speedup/production-overhead conclusion. Live heap deltas are not allocation counts; sampled allocation is statistical. No performance approval.
allocationMetricClarification: B starts CDP HeapProfiler sampling with interval32768 and default GC collection flags: these are statistical retained sampled allocations, not total allocation churn/rate. Do not compare directly to prior A sampling that included GC-collected objects. All three fresh B variants use the same sampling options.
candidateKernelCoverage: Two-owner fixture measures existing surface and surface-position kernels21 calls each; inclusive nesting is not additive. AIR/Cartesian calls are0 in that sampled workload; it is not universal worst-case candidate-cost coverage.
